cards.aggregate: SELECT a.id, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c.amount),0) FROM charges c WHERE c.account_id=a.id AND c.settled=1) - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.amount),0) FROM refunds r WHERE r.account_id=a.id AND r.approved=1) AS net FROM accounts a WHERE a.active=1 ORDER BY a.id;
cards.temporal:
SELECT a.id, COALESCE((SELECT e.state FROM events e WHERE e.account_id = a.id AND e.at <= 5 ORDER BY e.at DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT 1), 'NONE') AS state FROM accounts a WHERE a.active = 1 ORDER BY a.id;  
-- Check for cutoff compliance and tie-breaking logic if ambiguous.
cards.exclusion: SELECT a.id, COUNT(i.id) AS qualifying_count FROM accounts a JOIN items i ON i.account_id = a.id WHERE a.active = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM items bad WHERE bad.account_id = a.id AND (bad.status IS NULL OR bad.status <> 'ok')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM items amt WHERE amt.account_id = a.id AND (amt.amount IS NULL OR amt.amount < ?)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM blocks b WHERE b.account_id = a.id) GROUP BY a.id ORDER BY a.id;
